name: 哥特蕾丝烛光裙
description: 黑蕾丝高领 + 束腰 + 层叠裙摆 + 长手套 + 银十字。暗场单光源下最吃光的一套。
tags: black gothic dress, lace collar, high collar, corset, layered skirt, long sleeves, elbow gloves, silver cross pendant, dark stockings,
look_tags: black gothic dress, lace collar, high collar, corset, layered skirt, long sleeves, elbow gloves, silver cross pendant, dark stockings,
look_notes: 蕾丝高领是识别点，必须写 `lace collar + high collar` 两段 —— 只写 lace 会糊满全身。层叠裙摆配暗场要写 `layered skirt`，否则烛光下会糊成一片黑。
